subject: TOURN: results-of-record snapshot at tournament 'ended' (BLOCKING for any placement claim)
description:
Four-way vote 2026-09-07 named this the one blocking prerequisite under EVERY option. Today: no results lock exists. 'frozenStandings' (_app/admin/console.html:11952) is a SCOREBOARD-FREEZE suspense device and is deliberately deleted on transition to ended (console.html:11985-11988) so the reveal shows the real result -- correct for its own purpose. Consequence (Mallory, proven by source review): tournament-podium.html:427 only trusts frozenStandings while status=='frozen'; once ended it falls through to a LIVE re-sort of teams/. So any admin write (firestore.rules teams: allow update if isAdmin) or Cloud Function write after ended silently rewrites the official result, with no snapshot, no lock, no audit trail. HCA doc line 170 requires issuance to read a frozen tie-broken snapshot taken at ended. Also: the end transition itself is client-side (console.html:11915); functions/index.js has only ctfSubmitFlag/ctfJoinTeam/ctfLeaveTeam -- no server function ends a tournament. Tie-break logic itself is LIVE and correct (BUG-022, verified 2026-07-24).
[2026-09-07 23:08] COMMITTED 5ce97a33a, NOT DEPLOYED. Nancy PROCEED WITH CHANGES (all folded in), Mallory audited twice (both findings fixed), Chris PASS after re-running everything cold himself. Verified by execution: finalize 29/29 + rules 12/12 against the Firestore emulator, 16/16 rendering the real pages in headless Chrome against a record the real transaction produced. Five new test tools git add -f'd so they survive a clone. REMAINING: deploy needs operator authorization (functions + firestore:rules + hosting = production write gate). Residuals accepted and documented: BUG-254 (teams admin-writable before certification), BUG-255 (fixed), admin-console panel logic-traced not render-verified.
[2026-09-08 00:09] DEPLOYED + VERIFIED LIVE 2026-09-08. Functions: ctfEndTournament/ctfSubmitFlag/discordInteraction confirmed via functions:list. Hosting: all 5 markers confirmed serving from hexworth.com. Rules: production ruleset 4a183ba0 confirmed via firebaserules API to carry both status fences (create+update), the results block and write:if false. Deploy order was functions -> hosting -> rules deliberately; rules-first would have denied updateDoc while the old console still used it. NOT deleted: orphan Cloud Function updateStreak exists in prod but not in source - needs an operator decision, I refused to destroy it.
